data.name: Jumailah
data.long_meaning: The name Jumailah is derived from the Arabic word ‘jamila’ which means beautiful and ‘al-jamal’ which means garden or jasmine. The name Jumailah signifies a beautiful and fragrant garden, a place of peace and tranquility.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the beauty and fragrance of Jasmine, symbolizing the inner beauty and grace of the child, and reminding them of the divine presence of Allah (swt) in their lives.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jumailah is a source of pride for many families in the Islamic world who celebrate the birth of a child bearing such a beautiful and meaningful name. It is often used as a symbol of hope and aspiration, representing the cherished desire for a child who will bring joy, happiness and success to their parents. The name carries a positive connotation, and as such, it is often given to daughters in the belief that they will be just as beautiful and fragrant as the name suggests. In addition, the name Jumailah is often used in Arabic literature and poetry, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jumailah symbolizes the beauty and fragrance of the Garden of Paradise, which is the ultimate reward for believers in Islam. The name reminds us of the importance of leading a beautiful and virtuous life, one that is pleasing to Allah, and of striving towards the garden of Paradise, which is a place of peace, tranquility and eternal happiness. The name Jumailah also has a connection to the Prophet Muhammad's companion, Jumail ibn Manah, who was a poet and scholar. His devotion and love for the Prophet Muhammad inspired his poetry, which in turn, serves as a reminder of the spiritual significance of beauty in Islam.
